items.summary: CTO disposition: admit no new implementation this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with active measurement and open repairs. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next isolated, reversible implementation only after the saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case is completed or closed with root cause, deterministic tests, build validation, rollback point, and release boundary by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. The CTA change is technically feasible, measurable through registered affiliate clicks, and reversible without changing destinations, identifiers, credentials, telemetry, or cross-site behavior.

Do not admit the fleet-wide affiliate-attribution guardrail as active queue work yet. Preserve it as a deferred specification because it requires shared-registry coverage, repository/build integration, fixture coverage, and validation across sites; current capacity is full and registry completeness is not established. After capacity clears, prototype it in an isolated worktree with no production mutation, no provider attribution reassignment, and rollback by removing the validation hook.

Keep site-factory candidates readiness-only and unlaunched. Missing execution ownership, parked/private gates, and absent measurement or security evidence make public build or preview admission unsupported this cycle. Continue existing readiness artifacts only; do not add dependencies, domains, analytics, credentials, spend, or queue entries.

Preserve existing security, compliance, accuracy, and attribution gates. Do not request duplicate telemetry or infer revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift from aggregate affiliate data. New public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked pending the existing evidence work.

Deferred control-plane concepts remain research specifications only. Any future execution-ledger or AI-cost guardrail prototype must use existing records, run isolated and read-only or dry-run validation, define rollback and measurable acceptance criteria, and wait for an available delivery slot.
